timeout_seconds.description: Default timeout in seconds for each scraper process.

parallel.description: Whether to run scrapers in parallel.

merge_strategy.description: Default strategy for resolving conflicting data from multiple scrapers.

name.description: Unique name for the scraper, used in mappings.

path.description: Path to the scraper's Python entry point script.

cmd_template.description: Command template to execute the scraper. Use {path} and {output} placeholders.

output_path.description: Path where the scraper is expected to write its JSON output.

priority.description: Priority for this scraper's data during merging (higher wins).

confidence.description: A confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) for the data from this source.

mappings.description: Defines how to map data from scraper outputs to the template. Each key is a scraper name.

additionalProperties.description: A map of source keys (dot.notation) to template destination keys (dot.notation).
